narrative.overview: Mode: Read. The route is a compact comparison surface for weekly aggregate access scores. Preserve the existing typography, navigation, ruled table, striped page background, warm header and wordmark. Keep the scores and their interpretation legible without introducing another visual identity, decorative assets or promotional claims.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained, mostly neutral score presentation inside the incumbent branded shell.
Explicit measurement date, weekly history and visible score denominators.
Stable provider labels beside horizontally scrollable counts on narrow screens.
Honest pending and unavailable-run states with interpretation text retained.

rules.name: The Aggregate Rule
rules.body: Color must not imply a benchmark result that has not been published. An empty publication state stays empty.

rules.name: The Stable Column Rule
rules.body: Keep provider names and the access-rate column in separate fixed-width tracks. Preserve the explicit route override rather than inheriting the shared table's different column assumptions.

dos: Do preserve the existing benchmark shell and restrict this document's authority to `/stealth`.
Do keep provider names readable while the score region scrolls horizontally.
Do distinguish measurement date, week, access-rate denominator and planned-visit count.
Do retain an honest pending state and a visible history-based recovery for unavailable weeks.
Do identify populated captures as temporary synthetic-fixture QA and keep release verification limits explicit.
donts: Don't publish illustrative scores or treat fixture screenshots as measured results.
Don't infer general browsing reliability from this fixed difficult sample.
Don't imply the closed two-finding design review verifies a live campaign or deployment.
Don't expose targets, individual outcomes, private execution details or raw evidence.
Don't add a new visual identity, promotional claims, score charts or provider drill-downs to this scoped page.
